rules.heading: REJECTION OF CERTAIN YOGAS LIKE MRITYU, KRAKACHA ETC

planetary.freeform: Good effect due to Moon's auspiciousness in various houses (Gochara); some say good after one prahara, others say reject only for journey

rules.notes: Inauspicious yogas like Mrityu and Krakacha can become auspicious due to the Moon's good transit or after one prahara.

rules.heading: OTHER WAYS IN WHICH INAUSPICIOUS YOGAS ARE REMOVED

planetary.freeform: Presence of a strong auspicious yoga or a favourable Lagna destroys inauspicious yogas; Bhadra and inauspicious yogas like Vaidhriti and Vyatipata give good effects after noontime.

rules.notes: Auspicious yogas or a favourable Lagna neutralize inauspicious combinations, and certain negative periods like Bhadra or Vaidhriti yield good results after noon.
